title: Varesa Omarchy
description: A light theme in the pink and mint colors of Varesa (Genshin Impact). Unofficial, fan-made, generated from an Omarchy theme.

title: Mualani Omarchy
description: Dark and light themes in the surf colors of Mualani (Genshin Impact): ocean blue with her pink and yellow details. Unofficial, fan-made, generated from an Omarchy theme.

title: Melon Proto
description: melon 框架 proto 文件支持：语法高亮、跨文件智能补全、悬浮文档、跳转与大纲（clientdata / crossdata / proxymessage / enum）

title: Melon Phase Syntax
description: .phase 文件的语法高亮、格式化与资源跳转（phase DSL）

title: Google Colab GPU Status
description: Native VS Code status bar extension for Google Colab: live GPU/VRAM metrics, Compute Units balance, and one-click GPU/TPU/CPU runtime provisioning and stop controls.

title: ViewKeeper
description: See your dev server on several devices and routes at once inside VS Code. Scroll, clicks, typing and navigation stay in sync. Works with Vite, Next.js and any localhost app, hot reload and sign-in included.

title: 纸感阅读
description: 为编辑器、侧栏、终端和 Markdown 预览提供纸纹与阅读排版，可一键启用或恢复。

title: Agent Peeps
description: See which AI agent or subagent (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity) is working on which file, right in the Explorer.

title: ghost-trace
description: Finds phantom errors in your code on blank lines.

title: Android Developer Studio
description: Lightweight Android development in VS Code for Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, KMP & CMP — featuring New Project scaffolding, Android Project Explorer, Live Compose Preview, Recomposition Analyzer, Logcat Studio, Debugger, APK Analyzer, and Release Signing.

title: SnipGate-Solo
description: Show snippets only where they belong. Define rules in settings.json — regular expressions matched against the workspace-relative file path — and each rule points to a snippet file: its snippets appear as candidates only in files that match. Missing files in a multi-root folder are skipped silently.

title: Filecon Icons
description: File icon themes with 650+ file-type icons from the Filecon icon pack – in nine styles: Filecon, Gray, Solid, Papered, Papered Flat, Papered Craft, Scratch, Chalk and Iconic.

title: Python Statement Coverage
description: PyCharm-style coverage backgrounds across complete Python statements.
